LITBUY RESEARCH NOTE / WORKFLOW GUIDE

How to order through Litbuy: start with a complete product link

A practical, fact-led checklist for moving from a marketplace listing to an agent order without filling gaps with assumptions.

Independent guide. This page summarises publicly described Litbuy workflow features and practical checks. Availability, charges, routes and seller terms can change, so use the current order and parcel screens for a live decision.

Begin with the original listing

Litbuy describes a workflow in which shoppers submit product links and choose the relevant options. Before you send a link, open the original listing and record the precise variant, colour, size and quantity. A short title is not enough: one listing can hold multiple versions, materials or size charts. Keeping the exact option visible gives you something concrete to compare with the agent order screen.

Separate seller information from agent service

Litbuy operates as an agent and parcel-forwarding service rather than the marketplace seller. The seller still controls stock, listing photos, option names and seller-level return conditions. Read the original listing first, then confirm that the link and selected option have carried across in the agent order.

Keep a decision record

Save the listing URL, selected option, item price, stated measurements and any unanswered question. If there is a problem later, these notes make it easier to identify whether it began at the listing, purchase request, warehouse stage or parcel stage. Use the current order screen as the source of truth before you pay.
